obligation: G15 -- no CPU or dense fallback path executes during a sealed run
design: REFUSE-ON-ERR, not count-and-continue. The qwen38 decode has NO reconstruct-to-Q4 / dense / CPU fallback path (documented in source: qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:7 'there is no reconstruct-to-Q4 path', :956 'no reconstruct-to-Q4'). Dispatch is native-only: dispatch_mixed (:1571-1576) matches exhaustively over the 4 codec types {Binary, Residual, Hgravs, Uniform}, each decoding natively, with NO fallback/default arm; a missing weight Errs (:1570). Forbidden paths all refuse with Err: missing weight, wrong codec magic (:1360), reconstructed MLP (:265), missing GEMV / dense-Q4 fallback (:270,:1555), geometry mismatch. Unknown codec/role classification returns None (:576,:597) -> Err upstream.
counter_caveat: The FALLBACKS and DENSE_W_MATERIALIZED counters are DEAD TRIPWIRES -- initialized 0 and never incremented (the paths that would set them are Err instead), so their reading 0 is CONSISTENT but is NOT the evidence. This is the campaign's 'check that measures nothing' pattern; flagged so no future reader mistakes the constant-0 counter for the proof.
proof: no silent-fallback path EXISTS (every forbidden branch Errs; dispatch native-only) AND full 127-token generations COMPLETE WITHOUT Err on uniform-q4-v1, mixed-q3mlp-q3attn-v1, c-q3r1p22 (fallbacks=0, dense_w_materialized=0, coherent output). A completed generation therefore proves no fallback executed -- stronger than a counter, because a fallback cannot happen silently, it aborts.
verdict: VERIFIED. Zero fallback during sealed runs is proven by the refuse-on-Err design (no fallback path exists) plus completed full generations. Recommend (future): either wire the counters live or remove them, since a dead tripwire invites false confidence.
reopen_if: a new codec/role/reconstruction path is added without an Err guard, or a generation ever returns a fallback Err, or a dense materialization is observed.
